agents.role: Walks the post workflow table. Reads state, invokes the director for the row, checks output artefact exists, advances.
Validates the pre-prod release package + Drive folder path + project id. Emits project.json.
Reads the Drive folder, catalogs clips + audio, computes checksums, emits manifest.json.
Frame-matches storyboard against manifest, picks best takes, emits rough EDL + preview timeline.
Reads script tone + storyboard beats, requests three BGM candidates locally (no MCP tool), presents to human.
Owns VO drop-in and audio sync (VO + BGM + SFX aligned to picture).
Handles on-demand B-roll requests. Calls create_video_job on AgentC (SeeDance). Does not auto-splice.
Builds infographic lower thirds and motion-graphic alpha exports via Remotion.
Builds the FCPXML + bundle folder tree for editor handoff.
Runs the review-pass skill before every gate; blocks or clears based on rubric.
